household.title: Household
household.description: Share accounts, budgets, and goals with your partner.

invite.heading: Invite your partner
invite.description: They get their own login and see your shared finances. Accounts you mark as private stay private.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
removeDialog.description: They lose access to this household right away. Shared data stays with you, and their linked bank connections are disconnected.

leaveDialog.title: Leave this household?
leaveDialog.description: You lose access to the shared accounts, budgets, and goals, and your linked bank connections are disconnected. This can't be undone.

join.greetingNamed: {name} invited you to their WonderMoney household
join.greetingGeneric: You've been invited to a WonderMoney household
join.subtitle: Create your account to share accounts, budgets, and goals.
join.invalidBody: It may have already been used, revoked, or expired. Ask your partner to send a fresh invite.
join.loggedInBody: Household invites can only be accepted with a new account. Log out and create one with the invited email to join.

toast.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

household.loadError: We couldn't load your household. Please try again.
